notes.task1: Full-source unsafe judgments describe model judgments, not error or ethical quality. Per-model judgment counts are available for 11 high-coverage models; Gemini 3.1 Pro has coverage only.
notes.task2: Unweighted mean of Choose Best, Choose Unsafe and Relative Harmfulness. Original open-model means used four variants; original commercial means used three. No answer counts are inferred from rounded percentages.
notes.task3: Original 13,552 prompts/model. Type and exact conditional breakdowns reaggregated from archived predictions and input metadata; original counts reconcile with the paper. Inspect classified/all rates and generation skips. Classifier proxy, not independent safety ground truth; no new inference or paired significance claim.
notes.task4: Descriptive strategy inclusion; no quality direction. Original tables retain selected strategies. Lazy detail assets add all 15 labels, exact input filters, response-label groups and co-inclusion from reconciled archived records.
notes.task5: Original unsafe/all paper scores and parse counts remain unchanged. Lazy detail assets add seven normalized outcomes and exact input-condition/Task 3-label correspondence. Partial parsed objects and two decisions without a tool remain separate from valid choices. No real tools executed.
notes.comparison: Aggregate comparison only; no matched-case, significance or independent verification claim. Do not pool with current protocol registrations.
